title: Use the Time Sensitive interruption level only for notifications that are relevant in the moment

statement.en: Choose or apply the Time Sensitive interruption level only for notifications that are relevant in the moment in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではthe Time Sensitive interruption level only for notifications that are relevant in the momentを採用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Managing notifications experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるManaging notificationsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
